source: The Great Mother by Erich Neumann

entries.name: Demeter
entries.domain: Agriculture, harvest, fertility, Eleusinian mysteries, earth mother
entries.physicalCharacteristics: Mature woman with grain or torch
entries.significantEvent: Loss and recovery of daughter Kore/Persephone; Eleusinian mysteries; Thesmophoria festival with pig sacrifice
entries.symbolism: Positive Mother pole (M+); goddess of grain and harvest; pig sacrificed in Thesmophoria; mourning represents death/rebirth cycle of vegetation
entries.neumannArchetype: Occupies the positive M pole. Mother figure of the Eleusinian mysteries.

entries.name: Sophia
entries.domain: Wisdom, spiritual transformation, Good Mother archetype
entries.physicalCharacteristics: Radiant, associated with light and wisdom
entries.significantEvent: Projection of the Good Mother archetype; Sophia-virgin as positive anima
entries.symbolism: Good Mother projection; positive anima figure; represents wisdom and spiritual transformation; counterpart to Gorgon
entries.neumannArchetype: Represents the Good Mother projection, the positive pole of the Archetypal Feminine.

entries.name: Kore
entries.physicalCharacteristics: Young maiden, nearly identical in appearance to mother Demeter
entries.significantEvent: Abduction to underworld; Demeter-Kore mysteries of Eleusis
entries.symbolism: Daughter and partial figure of Demeter; mother-daughter genealogy; 'full grown and almost identical with her virgin-mother Demeter'
entries.neumannArchetype: Daughter and partial figure of Demeter. The Demeter-Kore relationship represents the mother-daughter unity.

entries.name: Uroboros
entries.domain: Primordial unity, self-containment, origin of opposites
entries.physicalCharacteristics: Circular snake biting its own tail
entries.significantEvent: Symbol of psychic state of the beginning; contains all opposites
entries.symbolism: Great Round; symbol of psychic origin; contains masculine and feminine; precedes differentiation into archetypes
entries.neumannArchetype: The 'Great Round' preceding all differentiation. Contains both masculine and feminine.

entries.name: Osiris
entries.significantEvent: Embraced by cedar tree; djed pillar as coffin; religion of Osiris and Horus promises rebirth to all souls
entries.symbolism: Djed pillar is both phallic-masculine and containing-feminine; cedar tree embraces corpse as earth-womb; promises universal rebirth
entries.neumannArchetype: His djed pillar is both masculine and feminine-containing. The cedar tree embracing his corpse represents the earth-womb.

entries.name: Tiamat
entries.domain: Primordial chaos, ocean, mother of gods, fate
entries.significantEvent: Defeated by Marduk; body split to form heaven and earth; 'mother of the gods and possessor of the table of fate'
entries.symbolism: Male-female uroboric unity with Apsu; primordial chaos of water; mother of all gods; split body becomes heaven and earth
entries.neumannArchetype: Key example of the uroboric Great Mother. Constitutes primordial male-female unity with Apsu.

entries.name: Gorgon
entries.physicalCharacteristics: Snakes writhing round her head; petrifying gaze that turns men to stone
entries.significantEvent: Turns men to stone with her gaze; projection of the Terrible Mother
entries.symbolism: Terrible Mother projection; terrifying aspect of the unconscious feminine; snake-haired; at negative pole M-
entries.neumannArchetype: Projection of the Terrible Mother, representing the negative pole of the Great Mother archetype.

entries.name: Artemis
entries.domain: Hunt, wilderness, moon, virginity, Great Goddess
entries.characterTrait: Virginal yet all-encompassing as Great Goddess
entries.physicalCharacteristics: Huntress; as Diana of Ephesus: many-breasted
entries.significantEvent: As Great Goddess, includes attributes of all poles; Hecate-Artemis cult
entries.symbolism: Virginal pole but also Great Goddess including all attributes; Lady of the Beasts
entries.neumannArchetype: As Great Goddess, includes attributes of all poles. The non-Greek Artemis is broader than the classical virginal version.

entries.name: Madonna
entries.domain: Mother of God, salvation, mercy, Stella Maris
entries.physicalCharacteristics: Sits on lion-adorned throne; sometimes depicted spinning
entries.significantEvent: Pieta (holding dead Jesus); Stella Maris (Star of the Sea); spinner of fate
entries.symbolism: Stella Maris paralleling Isis and Tara; Pieta as mother of death; Christian continuation of Great Mother; spinner of fate
entries.neumannArchetype: Christian continuation of Great Mother archetype. Stella Maris paralleling Isis and Tara.

entries.name: Lady of the Beasts
entries.significantEvent: Ancient Great Goddess form; Circe as Lady of the Beasts in Odyssey
entries.symbolism: Primordial Great Goddess form; sovereign over all animals; Potnia Theron
entries.neumannArchetype: Ancient form of the Great Goddess. Circe identified as Lady of the Beasts.

entries.name: Odin
entries.domain: Wisdom, fate, death, war, poetry, runes
entries.significantEvent: Hanging from Yggdrasil; takes wisdom from volvas (seeresses); relation to Mimir's spring
entries.symbolism: Bond with spring of fate; judgment seat at world ash tree; takes wisdom from feminine seeresses
entries.neumannArchetype: Takes wisdom from feminine seeresses. His hanging from Yggdrasil reflects relation to tree of fate.

entries.name: Hecate
entries.domain: Witchcraft, crossroads, underworld, moon, Terrible Mother
entries.significantEvent: Hecate-Artemis cult; associated with underworld and dead
entries.symbolism: Terrible Mother at negative pole M-; Hecate-Artemis fusion shows range of Great Goddess
entries.neumannArchetype: At the negative pole of the Great Mother. Along with Kali and Gorgon, represents the Terrible Mother.

entries.name: Tara
entries.domain: Salvation, compassion, navigation, Great Good Goddess
entries.physicalCharacteristics: Rides on lion; holds sun in hand
entries.significantEvent: 'Mistress of boats, capable of pacifying the watery flood'; savioress; 'the wise worship me as Tara'
entries.symbolism: Great Good Goddess; Stella Maris parallel to Madonna and Isis; 'redeeming one' (Tarini)
entries.neumannArchetype: Great Good Goddess paralleling Madonna and Isis as Stella Maris.

entries.name: Venus
entries.physicalCharacteristics: Exaggerated feminine features (Paleolithic Venus figurines); Venus of Willendorf
entries.significantEvent: Venus of Willendorf; Lespugne Venus; earliest Great Mother representations
entries.symbolism: Paleolithic fertility figurines; exaggerated hips, breasts, belly; earliest known Great Mother representations
entries.neumannArchetype: Earliest prehistoric representations of the Great Mother archetype (Venus figurines).

entries.name: Norns
entries.significantEvent: Spin and twist thread of fate; third breaks it off; shape hero's fate at night
entries.symbolism: Triple fate goddesses; spinning and breaking thread of destiny; past-present-future; birth-life-death
entries.neumannArchetype: Two spin and twist thread, third breaks it off. Represent beginning-middle-end, past-present-future.

entries.name: Ishtar
entries.domain: Love, war, fertility, Great Goddess, creatress
entries.physicalCharacteristics: With branches or ears of grain
entries.significantEvent: Descent to underworld; terrible and positive aspects
entries.symbolism: Great Goddess combining terrible and positive; creatress as potter (Mama/Aruru); with branches/ears of grain
entries.neumannArchetype: Both terrible and positive. At negative pole as terrible Ishtar, but also Great Goddess encompassing multiple aspects.

entries.name: Dionysus
entries.significantEvent: Opposition and reconciliation with Apollo at Delphi; relation of women to Dionysus
entries.symbolism: Ecstatic-matriarchal realm; relationship with women; opposition to Apollo is 'superficial'
entries.neumannArchetype: Exemplifies the ecstatic-matriarchal world. His relationship with women explored.

entries.name: Kali
entries.domain: Destruction, time, death, dark mother, blood sacrifice
entries.object: Skulls, severed heads and hands, necklace of skulls
entries.physicalCharacteristics: Many arms, dark-skinned, stands on corpse of Shiva, adorned with skulls
entries.significantEvent: Blood sacrifices at Kalighat (Calcutta); ~800 goats sacrificed at Durgapuja
entries.symbolism: Terrible Mother archetype; 'dark, all-devouring time'; stands on Shiva's corpse; devouring feminine
entries.neumannArchetype: Primary example of the Terrible Mother. 'Dark, all-devouring time.' Stands on Shiva's corpse.

entries.name: Aphrodite
entries.significantEvent: Also goddess of war in Sparta and Cyprus; enchants and ruins men
entries.symbolism: Golden Aphrodite who 'enchants and ruins men'; war aspect; Circe as Aphroditelike
entries.neumannArchetype: Seductive enchantress. Also has war aspect. Connected to Circe as 'Aphroditelike.'

entries.name: Maya
entries.significantEvent: World as Maya/illusion; as Heimarmene/fate; as monster or witch
entries.symbolism: Cosmic illusion; world as hell or Maya; fate as Heimarmene; goddess as the Maya, 'the great...'
entries.neumannArchetype: The goddess as Maya, cosmic illusion and fate.

entries.name: Eve
entries.domain: Life, origin, fall, mother of humanity
entries.significantEvent: Taken from Adam (unnatural symbol); Jewish life-affirming aspect
entries.symbolism: Unnatural origin from Adam reverses natural birth; 'the naked Eve. Her belly is life'; resembles Astarte and Gaea
entries.neumannArchetype: Her origin from Adam is an 'unnatural symbol.' In Jewish aspect, life-affirming.

entries.name: Huitzilopochtli
entries.significantEvent: Son of Coatlicue; Aztec war/sun god requiring human sacrifice
entries.symbolism: Hero god of the Aztecs; son of earth mother Coatlicue; sun warrior deity
entries.neumannArchetype: Aztec hero/war god, son of Coatlicue the earth mother.

entries.name: Sphinx
entries.physicalCharacteristics: Lion body, woman's head, wings; veiled sphinx of Tell Halaf
entries.significantEvent: Kills herself when Oedipus solves riddle; veiled sphinx of Tell Halaf with penetrating eyes
entries.symbolism: Kills herself rather than be defeated; same penetrating eyes as alabaster goddess; guardian figure
entries.neumannArchetype: Does not kill herself like defeated figure, but continues. Veiled sphinx with penetrating eyes.

entries.name: Mary
entries.domain: Mother of God, heaven, fire, feminine principles
entries.physicalCharacteristics: Goes under robe; associated with Holy Ghost
entries.significantEvent: Heaven goes under robe of Mary; upper and lower feminine principles kindled
entries.symbolism: Upper and lower feminine principles; Holy Ghost connection; continuation of Great Mother in Christianity
entries.neumannArchetype: Christian continuation of the Great Mother. Upper and lower feminine principles kindled through Mary.

entries.name: Persephone
entries.significantEvent: Same relation to corn mother as grain to earth; Eleusis mysteries
entries.symbolism: Relation to corn mother as seed to earth; associated with Demeter, Artemis; maiden becoming queen of death
entries.neumannArchetype: Stands in same relation to corn mother as seed to earth.

entries.name: Mayauel
entries.significantEvent: Goddess of intoxicant from maguey; Mexican Great Goddess
entries.symbolism: 400 breasts = superabundant nourishment; stars in celestial ocean; parallel to Diana of Ephesus
entries.neumannArchetype: Mexican Great Goddess with 400 breasts, symbolizing superabundant nourishment.

entries.name: Hel
entries.domain: Underworld, death, realm of the dead
entries.significantEvent: Rules the Norse underworld
entries.symbolism: Terrible Mother as ruler of the dead; Norse underworld goddess
entries.neumannArchetype: Norse death goddess representing the Terrible Mother as ruler of the underworld.

entries.name: Adonis
entries.significantEvent: Born from tree; mourned with breast-beating; seed grain symbolism
entries.symbolism: Born from tree like vegetation gods; ritual breast-beating mourning; seed grain taken to underworld and reborn
entries.neumannArchetype: Born from tree. Mourned with ritual breast-beating. Represents vegetation death-rebirth cycle.

entries.name: Gaea
entries.significantEvent: Linked with Eve and Astarte as earth mother figure
entries.symbolism: Earth mother; primordial feminine; linked to Eve and Astarte
entries.neumannArchetype: Earth mother figure linked with Eve and Astarte.

entries.name: Diana of Ephesus
entries.domain: Fertility, nature, Great Mother, many-breasted nourishment
entries.object: Many breasts, robe with beasts of zodiac
entries.animals: Beasts of the zodiac on robe and crown
entries.physicalCharacteristics: Many-breasted; robe and crown adorned with zodiac beasts
entries.significantEvent: Classical form of the Great Goddess of nourishment
entries.symbolism: Classical form of the nourishing Great Goddess; cosmic nourishment through zodiac beast adornment
entries.neumannArchetype: Classical form of the Great Goddess. Many breasts and zodiac beast adornment represent cosmic nourishment.

entries.name: Apollo
entries.significantEvent: Opposition to Dionysus at Delphi; Pythian Apollo
entries.symbolism: Opposition to Dionysus is 'superficial'; Delphi reconciliation; Pythian Apollo vs. ecstatic realm
entries.neumannArchetype: Opposition to Dionysus at Delphi is 'superficial.' Reconciliation of both at Delphi.

entries.name: Marduk
entries.significantEvent: Defeats Tiamat; creates heaven and earth from her body
entries.symbolism: Patriarchal sun god who defeats uroboric mother; creates ordered world from chaos
entries.neumannArchetype: Patriarchal sun god who defeats Tiamat, splitting her body to create heaven and earth.

entries.name: Bast
entries.significantEvent: Part of quaternary with Hathor, Neith
entries.symbolism: Part of Egyptian goddess quaternary; paired with Neith
entries.neumannArchetype: Part of the quaternary with Hathor and Neith in the Archetypal Feminine.

entries.name: Circe
entries.significantEvent: Enchantress who transforms men; 'always subject to defeat'; Lady of the Beasts in Odyssey
entries.symbolism: Personalized form of primordial enchantment; figure 'always subject to defeat'; Lady of the Beasts
entries.neumannArchetype: Enchantress figure 'always subject to defeat.' Aphroditelike Circe is also the Lady of the Beasts.

entries.name: Cybele
entries.domain: Mother of gods, earth, wild nature, mountains
entries.significantEvent: Stone of Pessinus moved to Rome; strangled victims as Gorgon
entries.symbolism: Mother Goddess who 'strangled them as Gorgon, as Cybele'; stone cult; from Pessinus to Rome
entries.neumannArchetype: Mother Goddess who 'strangled them as Gorgon, as Cybele.'

entries.name: Zeus
entries.significantEvent: Newborn Zeus fed with honey; realms shared by sons Zeus, Poseidon, Hades
entries.symbolism: Fed with honey as newborn; purest product of organic nature; shared mother's realms with brothers
entries.neumannArchetype: Newborn Zeus fed with honey. Shared the Great Mother's realms with his brothers.

entries.name: Ceres
entries.significantEvent: Ceres-Spes (Hope) association; bee symbolism; Cretan Great Goddess connection
entries.symbolism: Ceres-Spes (Hope); bee association with moon; Cretan Great Goddess; Demeter parallel
entries.neumannArchetype: Roman Demeter. Associated with Spes (Hope) and the Cretan Great Goddess.

entries.name: Baubo
entries.physicalCharacteristics: Belly goddess; body displayed as face (Priene figurines)
entries.significantEvent: Bares herself before grieving Demeter; Priene figurines
entries.symbolism: Belly character of the woman; ritual baring/obscenity as life-affirming; belly as face
entries.neumannArchetype: 'The belly character of the woman' is prominent. Bares herself before grieving Demeter.

entries.name: Hermes
entries.significantEvent: Hermes as soul-guide; snake-entwined healing staff of Hermes and Asclepius
entries.symbolism: Soul-guide (Seelenfuhrer); snake-entwined healing staff; guides between worlds
entries.neumannArchetype: Soul-guide. Snake-entwined healing staff of Hermes and Asclepius.

entries.name: Shiva
entries.significantEvent: Kali stands on Shiva's corpse; Shiva or Shakti contained in double symbol; 'the imperturbable'
entries.symbolism: Kali stands on his corpse; 'double symbol in which Shiva or Shakti is contained'; 'the imperturbable'
entries.neumannArchetype: Kali stands on his corpse. 'The imperturbable' contained within Shakti.

entries.name: Scylla
entries.significantEvent: Mother Krataiis connected to nether world
entries.symbolism: Devouring female figure; alluring and death-dealing; mother connected to underworld
entries.neumannArchetype: Among 'alluring and death-dealing female figures.' Mother connected to nether world.

entries.name: Eumenides
entries.significantEvent: Called 'sisters' by Aeschylus; grove at Sicyon; earth offerings
entries.symbolism: Erinyes/Eumenides; 'sisters' per Aeschylus; earth-connected; earth offerings characteristic of earth goddesses
entries.neumannArchetype: Aeschylus designates as 'sisters.' Receive offerings characteristic of earth goddesses.

entries.name: Valkyrie
entries.significantEvent: Choose the slain; associated with waelcyrge
entries.symbolism: Death-bringing feminine warrior; waelcyrge (chooser of the slain); associated with ravens and fate
entries.neumannArchetype: Death-bringing feminine warrior. Waelcyrge (chooser of slain) connects to fate.

entries.name: Durga
entries.significantEvent: Durgapuja festival with ~800 goat sacrifices; name means 'Unapproachable'
entries.symbolism: The 'Unapproachable' and 'Perilous'; Indian Terrible Mother; blood sacrifice
entries.neumannArchetype: The 'Unapproachable' and 'Perilous.' Indian Terrible Mother requiring blood sacrifice.

entries.name: Lilith
entries.significantEvent: Mesopotamian goddess of night, evil, death
entries.symbolism: Specter figure; 'Mesopotamian goddess Lilith of night, evil, and death, winged'
entries.neumannArchetype: Specter figure. Mesopotamian goddess of night, evil, and death.

entries.name: Maat
entries.significantEvent: Correlated with Sophia-Wisdom at positive pole
entries.symbolism: Justice and cosmic order; correlated with Sophia-Wisdom and Kore
entries.neumannArchetype: Egyptian goddess of justice correlated with Sophia-Wisdom at the positive pole.

entries.name: Tlazolteotl
entries.significantEvent: Earth goddess of sexuality and purification
entries.symbolism: Mexican earth/purification goddess; transformation aspect of the Great Mother
entries.neumannArchetype: Mexican goddess associated with the earth and transformation.

entries.name: Xochiquetzal
entries.significantEvent: Mexican goddess of beauty and flowers
entries.symbolism: Mexican flower goddess; beauty and fertility of the Great Mother
entries.neumannArchetype: Mexican goddess representing the positive, beautiful aspect of the feminine.

entries.name: Selene
entries.significantEvent: Listed among aspects of the Great Goddess
entries.symbolism: Moon goddess; aspect of the Great Goddess
entries.neumannArchetype: Listed alongside Persephone, Medusa as aspect of the Great Goddess.

entries.name: Eileithyia
entries.significantEvent: Goddess presiding over childbirth
entries.symbolism: Birth goddess; generative power of the Great Mother
entries.neumannArchetype: Birth goddess representing the generative aspect of the Great Mother.

entries.name: Asherah
entries.significantEvent: Asherah pole as symbol of Great Mother
entries.symbolism: Sacred pillar/pole as symbol of Great Mother; tree/pillar feminine symbolism
entries.neumannArchetype: The asherah pillar is a symbol of the Great Mother.

entries.name: Chicomecoatl
entries.significantEvent: Mexican corn goddess; 'Seven Serpent'
entries.symbolism: Mexican corn/vegetation goddess; nourishing aspect of the Great Mother
entries.neumannArchetype: Mexican corn goddess representing the nourishing vegetation aspect.

entries.name: Kwan-yin
entries.significantEvent: Listed with Isis, Demeter, Artemis, Ishtar as Great Goddess forms
entries.symbolism: Buddhist compassion goddess; Chinese Great Goddess paralleling Isis and Demeter
entries.neumannArchetype: Listed alongside Isis, Demeter, Artemis as forms of the positive Great Mother.

entries.name: Dictynna
entries.significantEvent: Paired with Britomartis as Cretan goddess
entries.symbolism: Cretan goddess paired with Britomartis
entries.neumannArchetype: Paired with Britomartis. Among many names of the Great Goddess.

entries.name: Tammuz
entries.significantEvent: Descent to underworld; mourned by Ishtar/Inanna
entries.symbolism: Dying-and-rising vegetation god; paired with Ishtar/Inanna
entries.neumannArchetype: Dying-and-rising god paired with Ishtar.

entries.name: Shakti
entries.significantEvent: Contained within Shiva; cosmic feminine principle
entries.symbolism: Divine feminine power; 'double symbol in which Shiva or Shakti is contained'
entries.neumannArchetype: 'Double symbol in which Shiva or Shakti is contained.' Cosmic feminine principle.

entries.name: Coatlicue
entries.physicalCharacteristics: Snake robe/skirt ('she of the serpent skirt')
entries.significantEvent: Mother of Huitzilopochtli; Mexican Terrible Mother
entries.symbolism: Mexican snake goddess; Terrible Mother; earth combining creation and death
entries.neumannArchetype: Mexican snake goddess representing the Terrible Mother.

entries.name: Rangda
entries.physicalCharacteristics: Witch figure with long hair and fangs
entries.significantEvent: Balinese witch representing the Terrible Mother
entries.symbolism: Balinese Terrible Mother/witch archetype
entries.neumannArchetype: Balinese witch representing the Terrible Mother archetype.

entries.name: Inanna
entries.domain: Love, war, fertility, heaven, underworld descent
entries.significantEvent: Descent to underworld; Sumerian precursor to Ishtar
entries.symbolism: Sumerian Great Goddess; precursor to Ishtar
entries.neumannArchetype: Sumerian precursor to Babylonian Ishtar.

entries.name: Attis
entries.significantEvent: Vegetation god associated with Cybele
entries.symbolism: Dying-and-rising vegetation god; paired with Cybele
entries.neumannArchetype: Dying-and-rising vegetation god associated with Cybele.

entries.name: Fortuna
entries.significantEvent: Parallels Indian/Tibetan Tara
entries.symbolism: Fate goddess in lion chariot; parallel to Tara; Great Mother as fate
entries.neumannArchetype: Sat in chariot drawn by lions, paralleling Tara on lion.

entries.name: Rhea
entries.domain: Motherhood, fertility, mountains, Mother of Olympians
entries.significantEvent: Mother of Zeus; saves Zeus from Kronos
entries.symbolism: Mother of the gods; Greek parallel to Cybele
entries.neumannArchetype: Mother of the gods. Greek parallel to Cybele.

entries.name: Nemesis
entries.significantEvent: Listed among aspects of the Great Goddess
entries.symbolism: Retributive justice aspect of the Great Goddess
entries.neumannArchetype: Among many aspects of the Great Goddess.

entries.name: Morrigan
entries.significantEvent: Celtic war/death goddess
entries.symbolism: Celtic Terrible Mother/war goddess
entries.neumannArchetype: Celtic war/death goddess representing the Terrible Mother.

entries.name: Cihuacoatl
entries.significantEvent: Aztec serpent woman/earth goddess
entries.symbolism: Mexican serpent woman; earth goddess; Terrible Mother
entries.neumannArchetype: Mexican serpent woman representing the earth goddess.

entries.name: Holda
entries.significantEvent: Germanic goddess of fate and spinning
entries.symbolism: Germanic spinning/fate goddess; continuation of Great Mother in folk tradition
entries.neumannArchetype: Germanic continuation of the spinning/fate goddess tradition.

entries.name: Groa
entries.significantEvent: Sings magic songs over Thor
entries.symbolism: Seeress who heals with magic songs; feminine wisdom figure
entries.neumannArchetype: Sings magic songs over Thor. Feminine wisdom/seeress tradition.

entries.name: Europa
entries.significantEvent: Abducted by Zeus as bull
entries.symbolism: Maiden figure; bull symbolism of the Great Goddess
entries.neumannArchetype: Connected to bull symbolism of the Great Goddess.

entries.name: Aruru
entries.significantEvent: Creatress/potter figure; variant of Mama/Nintu
entries.symbolism: Creatress as potter; creates humanity from clay
entries.neumannArchetype: Creatress/potter figure. Variant of Mama/Nintu.

entries.name: Mama
entries.significantEvent: 'Mama recited the incantation'; wise creatress with Ea
entries.symbolism: Wise creatress; recites incantations of creation; variant of Aruru/Nintu
entries.neumannArchetype: Wise creatress. 'Mama recited the incantation; when she completed...'
